statement: Annotated from the Beinecke scan alone (full page and a crop of the bottom left corner). The page is nearly all text: a block of paragraphs with, in the left margin, a column of about fifteen separate words and a column of single characters. The only drawing is a small group at the bottom left: a nude figure lying on its back with a rounded belly, two round objects, a small open cylindrical pot, and a few words in a different script. One line in the manuscript's own script stands directly above the figure; from the line ids alone this is taken to be f66r.82, the single label line that follows the paragraph text. The label lines f66r.1 to f66r.15 and f66r.16 to f66r.49 are taken to be the marginal word column and the single-character column; they are recorded as page furniture, not as labels of drawn objects, and only their first line id is given. The faint blue green shape across the page is show-through from the other side, not a drawing on this page.
